meter: USB power meter feeding the board's USB-UART port (display: V, A, mAh, Wh; read by eye)
method: each phase 600 s; energy = meter mAh x volts x 3.6 J, after subtracting the idle rate (8 mAh / 600 s) for the seconds the meter timer ran past 600 s; per inference = energy / runs; above idle = (mAh - 8) x volts x 3.6 / runs; the meter counts whole mAh (+-1 mAh per reading); one run per phase (no seeds, no repeats)
tools: tools/energy_loop.py (firmware: 0xE5 / TFLite loop on the first input, 'L:count,elapsed_us,class')

symbex.label: SYMBEX runs/max_int8_e100_s42, lut16 popcount, flash; exact against its simulation on the chip, 100 %

idle.label: idle, measured Nov 14 on the same board (ResNet-8 ENERGY.md)

tflite.label: TFLite Micro INT8, max seed 42 (same architecture, same recipe), ESP-NN, flash

notes: Accuracy differs: on HAR max INT8 is about 9 points more accurate (README); this energy buys speed, not equal accuracy.
